quest.title: The Littlest Journey: Medicine On-Hand
quest.description: Little Meng is making preparations for his trip...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Traveler, great timing! I was just looking to ask you something.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: He said that the journey is going to be a long one, and that we'll need some medicine.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Stuff for headaches, diarrhea, heatstroke, hangovers, stuff to help digestion... There's just a lot.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, why do they need stuff for hangovers...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What does hangover medicine have to do with business deals? It's not like business will boom the more you can drink, right?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Whatever the case, Dad wants me to go to Bubu Pharmacy to ask if the medicines have been prepared yet.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Could you accompany me there? There's something I'd like to ask you for help with.

choices.text: What's the thing you need help with?

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: We'll talk about it when we get there.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: Well, it's mostly Dad and his friends preparing... But Dad's also given me a task!

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Welcome. Are you here to procure a herbal remedy?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: ...Little Meng? What brings you here today?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: ...Oh, right. I remember now. You're here about those medicines, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Don't worry, they're almost all ready. I'll send them to your father in batches.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: That said, his order has drained our reserves of herbs, so some of those medicines will only be ready later.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Let me see... Well, the main thing we're low on is Mint, which has put a stop on heatstroke medicine production for now.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I mean, we are also taking medicine orders other than your father's...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Then...

choices.text: Looks like it's my time to shine.

response.speaker: Little Meng
response.text: I'm counting on you to get those herbs! I've got to stay here in the meantime and check those medicines, just like Dad asked me to!

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Haha, aren't you an earnest kid?

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Alright then, right this way. I'll go through this batch of medicines with you in detail.

response.speaker: Herbalist Gui
response.text: Have a look at these first. I'll bring the next batch out shortly.

choices.text: Just don't forget to pay me, now.

talks.objective: Give the Mints to Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Yes, these will be enough for me to make some medicine with.

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I'll put the heatstroke medicine into the next batch and have them delivered to you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Thanks, Big Brother Gui!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: And these are for you, Traveler. Thanks for your help! Let's head back now, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hehe, Dad will be pleased to hear this, I'm sure of it...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: One moment please, Little Meng.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: Weren't you supposed to check the medicines? You still haven't gone through the checklists in the back.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh... What? I... But I was checking for so long...

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: And there's more where that came from, Little Meng. Now then, let's continue the reviewing process...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Wah... Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you found the Mint?

dialogues.speaker: Herbalist Gui
dialogues.text: I need to review this checklist as well...
